newsitem.title: GREECE: Reuters Hellas has 598 mln drs 1996 pretax profit.
newsitem.headline: Reuters Hellas has 598 mln drs 1996 pretax profit.

text.p: Reuters Hellas SA, the Greek subsidiary of global news and information company Reuters Holdings Plc, said its pre-tax earnings rose 3.0 percent to 598 million drachmas on turnover growth of 15.4 percent, or 5.517 billion drachmas, in 1996.
Total equity stood at 499 million drachmas at the end of 1996.
Its balance sheet continued to exhibit zero gearing while also maintaining liquidity in excess of 300 million.

"We invested 318 million drachmas in fixed assets in 1996, which represents a net addition of some 27 percent, in order to offer our customers the latest quality products of Reuters technology," business manager Catherine Xanthakis said.
"Future plans include Securities 3000 products and Dealing Forwards (2000-3)," she added.

"We will continue listening to customers and anticipate and act upon their needs, sparing no efforts to globalise the domestic forex, capital and debt markets," Xanthakis said. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
